name: Langkawi International Airport

hours.quote: 2300 - 1500; Operations beyond 1500 required 8 hours prior notice to:

ppr.quote: Operations beyond 1500 required 8 hours prior notice to:

customs.v: customs and immigration 06:00-23:00 local (22:00-15:00 UTC) and on request

handling.v: handling by Malaysia Airlines, 07:30-23:00 local (23:30-15:00 UTC)

fuel.quote: 2300 - 1400 and upon request; JET A1; AVGAS

notes: Read Malaysia eAIP AD 2 WMKL, edition effective 19 May 2026 (complete). No curfew stated, but the aerodrome and ATS hours are 07:00-23:00 local and later operations need 8 hours' notice.
